messages.content: Explain quicksort

Quicksort works as follows: First, pick a pivot element. Then, partition the array so elements smaller than pivot go left, larger go right. Next, recursively sort both partitions. Finally, combine the results. This divide-and-conquer approach achieves O(n log n) average performance.

Why did the plant die?
The plant likely died due to lack of water. Without water, the plant couldn't perform photosynthesis. This led to cell dehydration. Eventually, the plant tissues died from starvation and desiccation.
